page.overview:
What is Scatha?

Scatha, known as the Worm, was a blind, silent

Little is told of Scatha's life, except that he was one of the mightiest Dragons to infest the Grey Mountains. den that "stank like a dark tomb" and contained a hoard of treasure which included "sharp bright stones" and a silver horn made by the Dwarves. He also collected bones as "toys", particularly "hands of dwarves and skulls of men" which he "piled in his den" as a "bed" and licked them clean.

After Scatha was slain by Fram son of Frumgar in the early days of the Éothéod, peace came to the land. However, a great feud or dispute began between Fram and the Dwarves of that region over Scatha's recovered hoard. The Dwarves claimed it as their own, but Fram rebuked their claim, refusing to even "yield them a penny" and instead sent them a necklace made from "the teeth of Scatha" along with an insulting message. It was rumored that the Dwarves killed him for this insult.

The Men of Éothéod likely retained at least some of the hoard since the horn taken by Fram from the hoard was brought south by Eorl to Rohan. was given to Meriadoc Brandybuck by Éowyn in the final months of the War of the Ring.
